_howToEdit: Each collection lists its items. To add a product, copy an item block, change the text, point 'image' at a file in assets/img (add a '-sm' copy for the grid), and set 'buyUrl' to your checkout link (Shopify, Stripe Payment Link, Gumroad, Square…). No code changes needed.
